India Women's Cricket Team Player Replaced for Lord's Test

Priya Punia has been named as the replacement for Pratika Rawal in the India women's cricket team for a one-off Test match at Lord's. Rawal was ruled out due to a knee injury. The Test match is described as historic, and the challenges of Test cricket were highlighted.
